5000022.c18_s3: It's always a good thing when you're nice to everyone.
5000022.c18_s4: I think you might need a new hairdo.

5000022.c22_f2: You don't want to mess with a Turkey, do you?
5000022.c22_f3: When my stomach is empty, my ears get clogged.

5000022.c24_f3: You must've been talking to that Mushroom over there.
5000022.c24_f4: Shaky hands? I see how it is...

5000022.c25_s4: I can feel your love from here, Master...

5000022.c26_f3: The way to a Turkey's heart is through his stomach.
5000022.c26_s1: If your love was money, I'd be a rich bird.
5000022.c26_s2: It's so nice to hear you say that!
5000022.c26_s3: My feathers only flap for you!

5000022.c27_s3: Go ahead. Wing it and see what happens...

5000022.c28_s4: Get some pepper and it will taste better.

5000022.c29_s1: I think I got 2 inches off the ground that time!
5000022.c2_f3: The sky is so nice... huh?

5000022.c30_s4: Go ahead, I've got another leg.

5000022.c32_f4: I had a White Bull potion, I'm fine.
5000022.c32_s1: You're so observant, Master. I'll take a short nap.
5000022.c32_s2: Feeling pretty sleepy, a nap would be good for me.
5000022.c32_s4: This spot is perfect for a quick snooze.
5000022.c3_f3: I feel fine, but thanks for the offer... gobble.
5000022.c3_f4: An empty belly encourages me to disobey
5000022.c3_s2: Take a seat? No problem! Gobble
5000022.c3_s3: You're so kind, Master. My legs were tired.
5000022.c3_s4: Ok, I'll get up when you say so.
5000022.c4_s1: A chickadee can follow that one. Too easy!
5000022.c4_s2: I do my best to obey, Master
5000022.c4_s3: A snack to show your appreciation would be nice
5000022.c7_f1: You need a potion? You look funny...
5000022.c7_f3: I've been a good pet for you, be nice.
5000022.c7_s2: I don't like that look... I'm scared
5000022.c8_f1: You already used your Mad ticket with me last time.
5000022.c8_f3: You're just shouting at me because you haven't eaten all day.
5000022.c8_f4: Not everyone can be a great Master, you'll get there with hard work.
5000022.c8_s3: I have feelings too, I'm hurt
5000022.c8_s4: Sorry, Master. I'll obey from now on.

5000022.f3_f: I don't think I'm hungry anymore.
